concepts.name: Architecture viewpoint
concepts.description: Reusable guidance for creating views that address a set of stakeholder concerns.

concepts.name: Architecture view
concepts.description: A system-specific representation created according to a viewpoint to address stakeholder concerns.

concepts.name: Viewpoint concern
concepts.description: A concern that a viewpoint is designed to expose, analyze, or communicate.

concepts.name: Model kind
concepts.description: A category of model used in a viewpoint, such as context, component, deployment, data, or state model.

concepts.name: View selection
concepts.description: The decision about which architecture views are worth creating for a system and situation.

concepts.name: Stakeholder question
concepts.description: A question a stakeholder needs answered to design, evaluate, build, operate, or govern the system.

concepts.name: View utility
concepts.description: The practical value of a view in answering concerns, reducing risk, or coordinating work.

concepts.name: Documentation economy
concepts.description: The practice of documenting enough architectural information to be useful without creating needless maintenance burden.

concepts.name: Architecture description package
concepts.description: The combined set of views, decisions, context, principles, risks, and supporting material used to describe an architecture.

concepts.name: Cross-view relationship
concepts.description: A connection or dependency between elements represented in different architecture views.

concepts.name: Architecture glossary
concepts.description: A shared vocabulary for system concepts, domain terms, architectural elements, and abbreviations.

concepts.name: Architecture template
concepts.description: A reusable structure for organizing architecture documentation and decisions.
